snippet.title: Cute robot solves mysteries on abandoned space craft | Indie Game Demo
snippet.description:
Got half an hour to kill? Try this fantastic indie game game demo about a robot with unique controls who has to uncover the mystery of why an old mining ship has returned.

Try the free browser based demo at https://squigalug.itch.io/control-yourself

#indiedeveloper #indiegames #demo #robot #space
